name: Office Building
headline: An office your team is glad to walk into.
intro: Desks, phones, break rooms and restrooms, cleaned on a schedule that fits your hours and never gets in the way of the work day.

name: Medical / Dental
headline: Cleaning that respects the rules you work under.
intro: Waiting rooms, treatment areas, restrooms and staff spaces, with specifications written around your practice's infection-control requirements.
regulations: We build your practice's infection-control and disposal requirements into the written scope before the first visit.

name: Schools
headline: Classrooms ready before the first bell.
intro: Hallways, restrooms, staff rooms and front offices, cleaned after hours so the building is ready for students every morning.
regulations: Background-checked crews and product choices that suit a building full of children.

name: Health Club
headline: Sweat is the point. Grime is not.
intro: Locker rooms, showers, floors and front desks, kept clean through the busiest hours of the day.

name: Auto Dealership
headline: A showroom as clean as the cars in it.
intro: Showroom floors, customer lounges, restrooms and sales offices, so the building sells the way the vehicles do.

name: Retail
headline: Customers notice clean. They remember dirty.
intro: Sales floors, fitting rooms, restrooms and back rooms, cleaned before you open or after you close.

name: Food Service
headline: Front-of-house clean, every service.
intro: Dining rooms, entrances, restrooms and staff areas. Tell us what your health inspector looks for and we build it into the scope.
regulations: Scope written around your local health-code requirements for customer and staff areas.

name: Real Estate
headline: Show-ready for every showing.
intro: Leasing offices, common areas, model units and vacant spaces between tenants.
